# Romain Fernex {.unnumbered}

::: {.intro}
Hello ! I am a predoctoral research assistant at **Bocconi University (IGIER)**, working with **Giulia Giupponi** and **Thomas Le Barbanchon** on projects related to Labour Economics and Polical Economy. 
:::

My work and academic projects focus mainly on labour and public economics, with a strong interest for topics that relate to socio-economic inequalities and alternative forms of employment (notably pluriactivity and self-employment which are at the core of my thesis). Be it as a RA or for my own projects, I like combining applied econometrics with structural modelling to quantify and understand economic mechanism in depths and am always open to trying new methods in computational social sciences wherever they genuinely outperform the old (especially when it comes to NLP !).

## About {.unnumbered}

I graduated from Sciences Po in 2026 (MPhil. Economics), following a Master in Management (major in Finance) at ESCP Business School and a dual-degree in consulting and data science at Korea University. Before joining IGIER, I worked as a research assistant to Jean-Marc Robin on testing a ML model (ridge) for firm and worker fixed effects estimations. This involved comparing how well this new estimator performed for this taks relative to standard biased and non debiased OLS models usually found in the AKM literature.

### [Self-employment and dual jobholding](thesis.qmd)

How the 2018 microentrepreneurship reform reshaped occupational choices in France, combining interrupted time series evidence with a structural occupational choice model.

[Read the overview →]{.card-more}

### [Workweek restrictions during the Great Depression](papers/labor-replication.qmd)

A replication and robustness analysis of Fishback et al.'s study of the 1933 President's Reemployment Agreement.
